sentences: When timer T901 expires, the terminal sends the SessionRequest message again at most three times.
After the third failure, it enters the idle state and informs the user.
In the idle state it sends no message on CCH1.
Idle is the default state after power-on.

requirements.text: When timer T901 expires, the terminal shall send the SessionRequest message again, at most three times.
After the third failure, the terminal shall enter the idle state.
After the third failure, the terminal shall inform the user.
In the idle state, the terminal shall send no message on CCH1.
After power-on, the terminal shall be in the idle state.
